title: Update TermsPage hidden admin link to word 'Sia'

requirements.summary: Update the hidden admin entry point in TermsPage.tsx so that the word 'Sia' appears as the very last word of the last condition, styled to blend naturally into the surrounding text, and clicking it navigates to /admin
acceptanceCriteria: The word 'Sia' is rendered as the last word of the last condition on the Terms & Conditions page.
The word 'Sia' is styled to visually blend into the surrounding paragraph text — matching font size, color, and weight — with no underline or other distinguishing decoration in its default state.
Clicking 'Sia' navigates the user directly to /admin without any password prompt or intermediate screen.
No other text content on the Terms & Conditions page is added, removed, or altered.
The entry point does not appear in the site header, footer, or any navigation menu.
The hidden link works correctly in both light mode and dark mode.

file_operations.description: Modify the last paragraph of the last condition to end with the word 'Sia' as a clickable link. Style the link element to match the surrounding body text (inheriting font-size, color, and font-weight from the paragraph) with no text-decoration in its default state. Use TanStack Router's Link component to navigate to /admin on click. Ensure the word 'Sia' appears naturally as the final word of the existing content without altering any other text on the page. The link must blend visually in both light and dark mode by inheriting CSS custom properties from the parent text.
